name: shadowstrike-prepare-x-3-power-plus-3-unblockable
notes: Shadowstrike (o191zv86la, UMBRA ATTACK, reserve 2, printed power 4): "Prepare X. X can't be 0. Shadowstrike gets +X POWER. [Class Bonus] If Shadowstrike was prepared, it has unblockable." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA); player 1 controls a Swift Recruit (Intercept) so blockability is observable. Shadowstrike is played for real (10002 FSM play + two reserve payments, 100 answers) and attacks player 1's champion. Champion has 3 preparation counters; player 2 pays Prepare X with X=3 (the maximum). FIXED (was: shadowstrike-prepare-x-never-wired-base-power-only, whose REGRESSION GUARD pinned 4 damage and 3 untouched counters because no Prepare prompt was ever queued; this fixture replaces it). Asserted: counters 3 -> 0, computed POWER 4+3=7, TurnEffects [o191zv86la_POWER_3, PREPARED], 7 damage to the champion, and the Intercept ally is never offered the attack (unblockable, decision queues empty after the attack step). Fixed in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php: a hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['o191zv86la:0'] queues a YES/NO 'Pay Prepare X?' then (on YES) a NUMBERCHOOSE for X in 1..preparation counters, removes X counters, sets wasPrepared=YES (GA_TagPreparedAttack then tags the intent PREPARED) and adds the 'o191zv86la_POWER_<X>' TurnEffect that ObjectCurrentPower() already read.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] If Shadowstrike was prepared, it has unblockable.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Shadowstrike's 'Prepare X (X can't be 0)' and 'gets +X POWER' were never wired: the generated ability set only had onAttackAbilities['o191zv86la:0'] and no $cardActivatedAbilities['o191zv86la:0'], so OnCardActivated() (confirmed live with a temporary error_log: hasCardActivatedAbilityEntry=0, pendingDQ-before=[]) queued no Prepare decision, no 'o191zv86la_POWER_<X>' effect (read by ObjectCurrentPower() but never written) was added, the PREPARED tag was never set and the [Class Bonus] unblockable branch was unreachable. The attack always dealt only its printed 4 and never cost preparation counters. Fix: hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['o191zv86la:0'] + ShadowstrikePrepareAsk/ShadowstrikePrepareX handlers in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php (YES/NO, NUMBERCHOOSE 1..counters, RemoveCounters, wasPrepared=YES, +X POWER TurnEffect).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php $cardActivatedAbilities['o191zv86la:0'] (new) feeding Custom/GameLogic.php OnCardActivated() / ObjectCurrentPower() / GA_TagPreparedAttack and Custom/CombatLogic.php's PREPARED unblockable check.
